status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
segments.note: ὁ ἀδελφός を「our brother」と訳す

segments.t: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae:
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（ἐν Κολοσσαῖς が後方へ）

segments.t: Grace to you and peace from God our Father
and the Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and the Lord Jesus Christ」（καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
segments.note: 語順のほぐし（ἐστὶν καρποφορούμενον καὶ αὐξανόμενον）

segments.t: even as you learned from Epaphras
our beloved fellow servant,
who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν（私たちのために）だが WEB は「on your behalf」と訳す（異本 ὑμῶν 系）

segments.t: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
segments.note: 「this」（11語目）は英語の補い

segments.t: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
segments.note: εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρεσκείαν を「to please him in all respects」とほぐす

segments.t: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ὑμᾶς（あなたがた）だが WEB は「us」と訳す（異本 ἡμᾶς 系）。μερίδα τοῦ κλήρου は「partakers of the inheritance」

segments.t: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
segments.note: 「our」（2回）は英語の補い

segments.t: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
segments.note: συνέστηκεν を「are held together」と訳す

segments.t: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
segments.note: πρωτεύων を「have the preeminence」とほぐす

segments.t: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
segments.note: 主語（神）は含意。εὐδόκησεν πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα κατοικῆσαι のほぐし

segments.t: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（二つ目の δι᾽ αὐτοῦ が「by him」として前方へ）

segments.t: whether things on the earth or things in the heavens,
having made peace through the blood of his cross.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（εἰρηνοποιήσας 節が文末へ）

segments.t: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
segments.note: 「your」（2回）は英語の補い。ποτε ὄντας は「being in past times」

segments.t: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
segments.note: εἴ γε を「if it is so that」とほぐす

segments.t: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
segments.note: ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα を「fill up on my part that which is lacking」とほぐす

segments.t: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
segments.note: ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γενεῶν を「for ages and generations」とほぐす

segments.t: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
segments.note: ἠθέλησεν を「was pleased」とほぐす

segments.t: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ
Jesus;
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Jesus」（Ἰησοῦ）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
segments.note: ἐν δυνάμει を「mightily」と訳す
